content: Jacob e-bab-Isaac-yardaksad
Isaac bato nue selebagusad, degi, aku-atakgusbalid. Ibagwengine, Isaac, e-machi-dummad-Esaúʼse gochad. Geb ega sogded: —¡Machi! Esaú abin-sogded: —Degite. ¿Ibua?
Geb Isaac sogdebalid: —Mag be an-daked, an nue-selebagusad. Ukiar sunna an burgwed.
A-ular, sapurba-nabi an be-abedo. Anga ibmar-maknaega warsi be sedo, sigu be sedbalo.
Ibmar be maksale, an mas-gunbidaedyob ise-nue-imakar be anga mas saoed. Geb we-mas-gunnega be anga sedagoed. A-sorba, an-burgwed-iduar, ise-nued-an-begi-binsaedgi an bega ibmar sogoed.
Isaac-Esaúʼga-ibmar-sogsadi, Rebecaʼdi bela itosad. A-ular, Esaú sapurba e-babga ibmar-maknadgu,
a-sorba, Rebeca e-machi-bipigwad-Jacobʼga sogded: —Nue be an-itogo. Be-bab, be-ia-Esaúʼga sunmakgwisgu, ega-soge an itosad:
‘Sapurba be ibmar-maknaye, a-mas ise-nue-imakar anga be saoye. Geb an burgwed-iduar Bab-Jehová-asabin, an-begi-ise-nued-binsaedgi an bega ibmar sogoye.’
Machi, degisoggu, nue be an-itogo. An-ibmar-bega-sogoedba, bela be imako.
Degisoggu, sibadmar-bukwadse be nae, sibad-mimmi-senigwad-warbo-bur-nuedid be anga sedago. Be-bab mas-gunbidaedyob an ise-nue-imakar an ega mas saoed.
Geb degine, be-bab a-mas-gunnega ega be sedoed. Adi, be-bab e-burgwed-iduar, ise-nued-binsaed bega sogoed.
Ar Jacobʼdi e-nan-Rebecaʼga sogded: —Ar nabir be sogendo. Ar an-iadi wawaad. Andi degisulid.
Ar an-bab an-abagan-ebualile, mag an-itogoed, ande an Jacobʼad. Geb angi binsaoed, an egi dodonaiye. Ar bur an-ukabsaoed, ise-nued-angi-binsaed bar anga sogosulid.
Ar e-nandi Jacob-abin sogded: —Machigwa, be ukabsaleye sogele, ani an ukabsalegoed, bedi ollordo. Degisoggu, an-ibmar-bega-sognaidba be imake. Sibad-mimmi-senigana-warbo be anga sedage.
Jacob sibad-mimmi-seniganabina naded. Geb e-nanga senonikid. Agi e-nan Isaac-mas-abedaedyob sibad-e-san ise-nue-imakar imaksad.
Geb degine, Rebeca, e-machi-dummad-Esaú-e-mor onosad. A-morde bur mor-nuedid, e-neggi ise-nue-saboar bukwad. Agine, Rebeca e-machi-bipigwad-Jacobʼga a-mor-yoega uksad.
Geb deginbali, Rebeca sibad-bipi-e-uka-wawaadgi Jacob-e-surgan, degine, e-dukarba obipirmaksad, bia absarsuli-nanaedgi nasiksad.
Geb degine, Rebeca mas ise-nue-saale Jacobʼga uksad, adi, Jacob e-bab-Isaacʼga ukegar. Geb madu-imaksadi ega uksabalid.
Geb degine, Jacob, e-bab-siidse dogdapid, ese gordapid: —¡Baba! Isaac abin-sogded: —An wegi sii. ¿Be biti-an-machi?
Jacob abin-sogded: —An, Esaú, be-machi-dummad. Be anga-sogsadba bato an imaksad. Baba, be-dage. Wis wese be sigdage. An-ibmar-maksad be gundage. Geb be ise-nued-angi-binsaed be anga sogoed.
Geb degine, Isaac e-machiga sogded: —Machi, ¿igi nabir bato be ibmar abingusbinne? Jacob e-bab-abin sogded. —Bab-Dummad-Jehová gwae-gwae ibmar-abinguega an-bendaksad.
Ar e-bab-Isaacʼdi abin-sogded: —Anse be dage, an be-ebubie, bule be an-machi-Esaú-sunnaddibe.
Jacob e-bab-walikaa naded, adi, e-ebugegar. Geb degine, Isaac sogded: —Be-sunmaked Jacobʼyob be sunmaked. Be-sakwamardi Esaú-sakwamar an itoged.
Isaac Jacob-e-sakwamar e-ia-Esaú-sakwamaryob absar yaisur-itossoggu, Isaac magar-itossulid. A-ular, Isaac ise-nued-binsaed Jacobʼga soged-iduale,
gannar Jacobʼga sogded: —¿Ar nue be an-machi-Esaú-sunnadi? Jacob abin-sogded: —Eye, an Esaú-sunnadi.

Geb degine, e-bab Jacobʼga sogded: —Machi, anga be mas dake, adi, be-ibmar-maksad an gunnegar. Geb a-sorba, an-ise-nued-begi-binsaed an bega sogoed. Jacob e-babga mas daksasunnad, degi, ega vino senonibalid. Isaac nue-mas-guchad, degi, nue-gobsabalid.
Geb degine, Isaac Jacobʼga sogded: —Machi, anse be dage, be an-wagar udage.
Jacob e-bab-wagar-uega e-bab-walikaa nonigua, e-bab, Jacob-mor-yoid usad. Geb degine, Isaac, Jacobʼgi-nued-ise-binsadedba, ega weyob sogded:

content.text: orosgi-dakleged-e-gwag-bukidar bega ukoed, vino-bukidar bega ukoed.

content: Isaac, ise-nued-binsaed-Jacobʼga-sognaid bergusgua, Jacob nodeyalaba, Esaúʼdi sapurba-ibmar-makdiid dognonikid.
Esaú mas nued-gulle e-babga imaksamogad. Geb e-babga sesa gusad, ega sogdapid: —Baba, be gwisgu. Be-machi, bega ibmar-maksad be gunne, be-angi-ise-nued-binsaed be anga sogsun.
Geb degine, Isaac, Esaúʼga sogded: —¿Be doa-dule? Esaú abin-sogded. —Ani, an Esaú, be-machi-gebesailagined.

Isaac geger-itoged, nue-wawanmake sogded: —Degite, ¿wede doa be-iduar ibmar-maksad, yeer-gulle anga senonisunna? Be-nonikid-iduar, dule-anga-mas-senonikid bela an guchad. Bato be-iduar-dule-arbidga, egi ise-nued-binsaed bela an ega sogsad. Ar emigindi, bato egi ise-nued binsalessunnad. Geg bar an oakaloged.
Esaú, e-bab weyob ega soge itosgu, nue-nunmak binnasur ise-ogormakar boded. Geb e-babga sogded: —¡Baba, ise-nued-binsaed be anga sogmoga!
Ar Isaacʼdi e-machi-abin sogded: —Be-urba bato anse arbid. An-yardaksad. Ise-nued-binsaleged begadinad, be-ibe atursasad.

Geb Esaú sogded: —¡Ar nabir ega Jacobʼye nug nasiksamala! ¡Ar emide ilabogus an-yardakdanikid! Gebe unni, an machi-sailagined-guedba anga ibmar-uklegoenad an-ibe susad. Emide, angi ise-nued-binsaleged an-ibe susbalid. Esaú sogdebalid: —Baba, degite, angi ise-nued-binsaleged, ¿wis be anga obessuli?

Geb degi, e-bab-Isaac abin-sogded: —Be-dummadga-gued-igar Jacobʼga an uksad. Bela e-gwenadgan e-maiga-gued-igar, an ega uksabalid. ”An-ise-nued-egi-binsaedba, an ega sogsabalid: Bitigi orosgi-dakleged-bukidar nikuena gadinye, degine, vino-bukidar nikubalina gadinye. Ar emigindi, machi, ¿igi-bar-an-saosunna?”
Esaú e-babgi alamaknai gusad: —¿Baba, be-ise-nued-binsaed wis soggwensaar geg be anga soge? ¡Be angi ise-nued binsamoga! Degine, Esaú gannar ise-ogormakar bodbalid.
Geb, Isaac na e-machi-Esaúʼga sogded:

content.text: Be-es-suidgi na be san bendakdii guoed.

content: Jacob wakited

Weyob-gusad-akale, Esaú, Jacob-sae-dakded, ar ade, e-annik ise-nued-egi-binsaleged egwachad. Degisoggu, Esaú binsadisunnad: “Emisgwasaar an-bab-burgosoggu, aba anmar bukib-binsadii guoed. A-sorbali, an-urba-Jacob anse oburgwilegoye.”
Rebeca wisgusgu igi e-machi-dummad-Esaú binsadii, e-machi-bipigwad-Jacobʼse gochad, ega sogded: —Be-ia-Esaú be-oburgwebi gudiid. Yamo baisur-itogeyob gudiid.
Degisoggu, machi, nue be an-itogo: Emisbinne, Harán-neggweburse an-sus-Labán-e-negse be wakinne.
Agi, be-ia sae-itoged baisur-ito-gusadse be undar gudii guoed.
Be-ia-Esaú ibmar-iegedse be gudii guoed. A-sorba, be gannar-dagega an be-owisogoed. Ar iba-galagwengi an-masmala-warbobela an surgubisulid.

Geb degine, Rebeca e-sui-Isaacʼga sokalid: —Esaú, Het-dule-e-sisgwa-nikusad-ular, an budar-itogusad. We-Canaán-yargi Het-dulemar-bukwad-e-sisgwa-wargwen-weyob-damogadi Jacob nikusale, ar an bur burgwed, nabirid.
